summary: This clinical trial is testing a combination medicine called a polypill to help prevent heart failure in adults with type 2 diabetes and high blood pressure. The study is currently Recruiting and aims to include 200 participants. Researchers will compare taking the polypill to taking the individual medicines separately over a six-month period. The sponsor for this study is the University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center, and the trial has a Phase 1/2 designation.

facts.sponsor: University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center
